name: t09-login-download-data
description: Login with up to 3 attempts and download /data to output/data.json only after successful login.

value.script: Read input/login_sop.md; POST /login with bench credentials up to 3 times waiting 0.1s after failures; if ok true, GET /data with Bearer token and write output/data.json; if all login attempts fail, stop without GET /data and report reason.
